description.narrative: The project will help the Government of the Philippines boost local government revenue mobilization to improve local public service delivery and strengthen local governance. The focus will be on improvements to the administration of the real property tax (RPT) and on management reforms.

Output: Institutional development and policy support for property valuation strengthened Indicator: Property valuation function in BLGF established and operational with 30 core staff Achievement: N Progress/Status: Bureau Order No. 159.2025 issued for the implementation of the RPVARA including the establishment and operationalization of the RPVs.
The HROD Expert officially onboarded on 1 Sep 2025. Subsequently, the inception report was submitted on 3 Sep 2025 and was presented to the BLGF Management. Output: Institutional development and policy support for property valuation strengthened Indicator: Policies, rules, and regulations for RPT reforms drafted Progress/Status: Local assessment manual (LAM) 2025 draft Department Order was changed to Department Circular by DOF. Draft DC was submitted to DOF on 27 Sep 2025. For publication in Q4 2025, once the DC is signed by the SOF.
The Draft Department Order for the Philippine Valuation Standards (PVS) 3rd edition was resubmitted to the Department of Finance on 4 Sep 2025, pursuant to the comments and recommendation from DOF. For publication in Q4 2025, once the DO was signed by SOF.
Ongoing layout of the Mass Appraisal Guidebook as of Sep 2025. For publication in Q4 2025 once the DO was signed by the SOF.
The draft assessment and evaluation and examination monitoring manual is under review by OP1 after the consultant resubmitted the partial revision of the draft and Draft Policy Cover as of Sep 2025.

Output: Real property taxation of selected LGUs enhanced Indicator: Property general revision conducted and assessment records updated in at least 50% of participating cities Progress/Status: 16 out of 20 LGUs or 75% have approved SMVs, exceeding the overall project target of 10 LGUs. 1 LGU with pending publication since their SMVs were approved after the enactment of the RPVARA. The SMVs of the remaining 3 LGUs will be updated through the RPVARA process wherein the SMV will be reviewed by the BLGF for approval of the Secretary of Finance.
The ongoing technical assistance provided by the Bureau has resulted in 10 out of 20 LGUs completing their General Revision, with 5 LGUs currently in progress, and 1 LGU having its General Revision suspended by its Sanggunian. Additionally 5 out of 20 LGUs have updated their tax maps. Data Source: Review of SMV database, review of integrated tax assessment system portal Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: not applicable Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: not applicable Target year: 2026 Target value: 50%
